version.changelog:
wine-info-search v1.6.1

- Updated SKILL.md: clarified description, added 'capabilities', and improved API key guidance for security and accuracy.
- Reworded documentation to emphasize search-only scope and no need for OAuth tokens or sensitive credentials.
- No functional or core behavior changes to the skill logic.

llm.summary: This is a disclosed read-only wine lookup skill with optional external searches and general alcohol guidance, but no hidden purchases, account changes, persistence, or data theft behavior was found.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts coherently describe wine information search, price comparison links, OCR label lookup, optional Firecrawl/Vivino access, and health/drinking guidance. Marketplace capability tags appear overbroad, but the actual skill files repeatedly limit behavior to search and display.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to running the wine_search.py script, using WebFetch for price pages, and treating third-party fetched content as data only.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No auto-installer or persistence setup is present. Core functionality uses the Python standard library; optional OCR dependencies are pinned in requirements.txt.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Wine queries may be sent to Wine-Searcher, Vivino, Wikipedia, Open Food Facts, shopping/search platforms, and optionally Firecrawl. The optional Firecrawl API key is disclosed and documented as read-only search use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background worker, startup hook, credential-store access, destructive file operation, or broad local indexing was found. Local file use is limited to user-provided label images for OCR.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending wine search terms to external wine, shopping, Wikipedia/Open Food Facts, and optional Firecrawl services. Treat the health section as general information, not medical advice, and prefer FIRECRAWL_API_KEY as an environment variable rather than a command-line argument.
llm.findings: [SDI-2] expected: The health and drinking-advice module is real and includes age- and condition-based limits, but it is disclosed in the skill purpose and documentation with medical disclaimers; this is a user-risk note, not evidence of hidden or malicious behavior.
